posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
For students who have updated their ssh key and are not able to login, please upload your NEW ssh key here

Email not allowed means you are not eligible for OPPE.

if you facing this error

@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@
@    WARNING: REMOTE HOST IDENTIFICATION HAS CHANGED!     @
@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@
IT IS POSSIBLE THAT SOMEONE IS DOING SOMETHING NASTY!
Someone could be eavesdropping on you right now (man-in-the-middle attack)!
It is also possible that a host key has just been changed.
The fingerprint for the ED25519 key sent by the remote host is
SHA256:W6T90REIksiknnGUtrgpkulEcWy2n0Xqhxycl10Iovw.
Please contact your system administrator.
Add correct host key in /home/krishnan/.ssh/known_hosts to get rid of this message.
Offending ED25519 key in /home/krishnan/.ssh/known_hosts:67
Host key for sc-oppe.study.iitm.ac.in has changed and you have requested strict checking.
Host key verification failed.

type
ssh-keygen -R sc-oppe.study.iitm.ac.in
